subject: Retention carveout and evidence request for Chronos Health
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@chronoshealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@chronoshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Retention carveout for debug/session logs and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — Chronos is excited about Redwood's latency profile. A quick compliance ask from our security team: we have a subset of clinical systems that require 180-day forensic retention for session/debug artifacts (medical device integration). Redwood's standard session TTL is 30 days per our docs — can you confirm whether a customer-specific carveout is possible and what controls you require?

Concretely, the Chronos security lead wants:
- A one-page statement of how a 180-day retention carveout would be scoped (tenant-scoped; not global)
- SIG / CAIQ artifacts that map to the evidence we would add to our vendor profile (SOC 2 report + supplemental artifacts if possible)
- A short description of how we could request deletion or trigger a legal hold later (audit trail + proof-of-delete)

If this isn't something you handle directly, please point us to the best internal contact. We need to close this in our risk review by Nov 30.

Appreciate the quick help,

Maya Singh
Security Program Manager
Chronos Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention carveout for debug/session logs and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Thanks Naomi — putting an initial plan together. Summary of what I recommend we provide to Chronos:

1) Chronos-specific retention carveout (tenant scope):
   - Implementation: tenant-anchored retention policy that overrides default 30d TTL and extends debug/session artifacts to 180d only for listed tenant IDs and named integrations.
   - Controls: access limited to SRE on-call + designated customer success engineering (CSE) leads; encryption-at-rest with tenant-scoped keys (KMS) where enabled; audit logs for any access or export.
   - Compensating controls: periodic retention sampling report + immutable export snapshot on request.

2) Proof-of-delete and legal hold flow:
   - Proof-of-delete: we can produce a signed manifest showing which objects were deleted, object IDs, timestamps, and storage lifecycle events (S3 delete markers / retention-lifecycle logs).
   - Legal hold: we can freeze the tenant-specific retention policy and export an immutable snapshot to the secure escrow bucket; all access requests generate an audit ticket.

3) Evidence pack: SOC 2 report (redacted where required), SIG mapping matrix, and a supplemental playbook that outlines retention SLOs and sampling artifacts.

I'll attach a draft supplemental playbook and a CSV that maps retention buckets -> artifacts for their review. Kimberly — any issues sharing the draft playbook and a zipped evidence set to a prospect under NDA?

Attachments: chronos_supplemental_retention_playbook.pdf, proposed-mmap-20271120.csv

Ben Carter
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

- Naomi: once Ben confirms attachments, please share a short customer-facing summary and an invite for a 30-min technical workshop the week of Nov 22.

I'll prepare a simple addendum template for the retention carveout (legal template will be kept internal until customer acknowledges).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Retention carveout proposal and next steps (Chronos Health)

Hi Maya / Alex — thanks for the clear ask and patience while we pulled artifacts together. Attached are the initial materials for your risk review: a supplemental retention playbook (tenant-scope), a mapping CSV that ties the retention buckets to expected artifacts, and a preliminary SIG/SOC bundle.

Key notes:
- Scope: this is a tenant-scoped 180-day retention carveout limited to the integration IDs you provided. It does not change global defaults or other customers' data.
- Controls: restricted SRE/CSE access, KMS-backed encryption where enabled, audit trail for any exports or manual restores.
- Proof-of-delete: if Chronos later requests deletion, we will provide a signed deletion manifest with object IDs and lifecycle event timestamps; for legal holds we will create an immutable snapshot and place it in escrow (DocuSign workflow required to approve export + escrow).
- Artifacts: SOC 2 summary + redacted report available under NDA; CAIQ mapping included in the ZIP. Full SIG/CAIQ evidence will need an executed NDA; draft attached for your review.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether the listed integration IDs match the scope you intended.
2) If you want to proceed, sign the attached NDA and we will schedule a 30-min technical workshop (I propose Tue Nov 23 or Thu Nov 25).
3) Post-workshop we will issue the retention addendum and a DocuSign link to approve escrow/export conditions.

Attachments in this thread: chronos_supplemental_retention_playbook.pdf; sig-evidence-pack.zip; proposed-mmap-20271120.csv

Link to shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBCDexampleEvidence
DocuSign link (escrow approval): https://redwood-docusign.example/signature/ABC123

If you want a narrower scope (e.g., 90 days) to start faster, we can do that as a phased pilot.

Best,

Naomi Feldman
